# Category Model

## Purpose
The Category Model provides a generic way to categorize any entity (Baseclass) or class (Clazz) in the system.

## Key Entities
- **Category**: Defines a category name and description.
- **CategoryToBaseClass**: Links a Category to a specific Baseclass instance.
- **CategoryToClazz**: Links a Category to an entire Clazz.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Category
    Baseclass <|-- CategoryToBaseClass
    Baseclass <|-- CategoryToClazz
    CategoryToBaseClass "many" -- "1" Category
    CategoryToBaseClass "many" -- "1" Baseclass
    CategoryToClazz "many" -- "1" Category
    CategoryToClazz "many" -- "1" Clazz

    class Category {
        +String name
        +String description
    }
    class CategoryToBaseClass {
        +Category category
        +Baseclass baseclass
    }
    class CategoryToClazz {
        +Category category
        +Clazz clazz
    }
```
